launch_plan.shared_design: One large focal point, scale or consequence visible at 168x94. House heavy sans, one yellow hook word, other words white, outline, clear top or edge band, no Orbit, no small text. Grade (mean saturation >=100, target 120; near-black <=30%) and phone-preview gates apply.

concepts.rule: LEARNINGS rule 19 — single clean real spacecraft frame, graded, 0-3 words, no composite
concepts.picture: Single striking real New Horizons exposure of Pluto showing the bright creamy expanse of its heart-shaped nitrogen glacier Sputnik Planitia bordered by reddish-brown cratered terrain, graded to high contrast and saturation (no composite, no added foreground objects).
concepts.source_image: NASA/JHUAPL/SwRI New Horizons real frame PIA20291 (MVIC enhanced natural-colour global portrait of Pluto and Sputnik Planitia, 14 July 2015) or PIA19952.

concepts.rule: LEARNINGS rule 12 — distinct picture concept showing scale/consequence
concepts.picture: One suited explorer stands on the smooth polygonal nitrogen plains of Sputnik Planitia looking up at towering 3-kilometre jagged mountains of rock-hard water ice while giant Charon hangs stationary in the sky.
concepts.source_image: Original illustrative scene referenced to real NASA/JHUAPL/SwRI New Horizons oblique mountain and Sputnik Planitia mosaic PIA19948 / PIA20027 (14 July 2015).

concepts.rule: LEARNINGS rule 14 — bright high-contrast background test
concepts.picture: Pluto's backlit silhouette surrounded by its brilliant electric-blue atmospheric haze layers shining brightly across the frame, breaking the standard dark space template.
concepts.source_image: Graded from real NASA/JHUAPL/SwRI New Horizons high-resolution blue-crescent departure portrait PIA19968 (taken from 200,000 km away on 14 July 2015).
